import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    score_feed = inputs["score_feed"]
    score_snapshot_old = inputs["score_snapshot"]

    # Step 1: STG_CURR = SELECT account_id, AVG(score) AS avg_score
    #         FROM score_feed GROUP BY account_id
    stg_curr = (
        score_feed.groupby("account_id", dropna=False, as_index=False)
        .agg(avg_score=("score", "mean"))
    )

    # Step 2: DELTA computed against the OLD (pre-update) snapshot
    delta = stg_curr.merge(
        score_snapshot_old,
        on="account_id",
        how="left",
        suffixes=("", "_prev"),
    )
    delta["avg_score_prev"] = delta["avg_score_prev"].fillna(0)
    delta["score_delta"] = delta["avg_score"] - delta["avg_score_prev"]
    delta = delta[["account_id", "score_delta"]]

    # Step 3: SCORE_SNAPSHOT is replaced entirely with STG_CURR
    score_snapshot_new = stg_curr[["account_id", "avg_score"]].copy()

    return {
        "delta": delta,
        "score_snapshot": score_snapshot_new,
    }
